title: Levo X Racer Grey

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Caberg Levo X Racer Grey combines flip-up modular convenience with highway touring comfort, delivering flip-up versatility for city stops and sealed protection at speed. Built around a Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell weighing a featherweight 1288g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~86 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across ECE 22.06 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

product_details.description: Carbon shell modular with panoramic visor and antibacterial lining.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for a snug, locked-in fit typical of the Levo X line; features an intermediate oval head shape with a slightly lower profile to accommodate aerodynamic fairings.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Caberg Levo X Racer Grey: combining Global Certified craftsmanship with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release and Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Caberg Levo X Racer Grey: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Caberg Levo X Racer Grey. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Caberg's Modular lineup, the Levo X Racer Grey brings Italian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified ECE 22.06 track safety.
story:
The Caberg Levo X Racer Grey represents Caberg's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~86 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Aerospace-Grade 100% Carbon Fiber Modular helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Caberg Levo X Racer Grey delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
